description: Create an invitation draft from a description of the party in plain words: who it is for, age, date, time, place, theme, colors. Optionally pass design_id from find_designs. Returns a preview link, the link to get it, what was filled in and what is still missing.

design_id.description: A design id from find_designs, if the user picked one.

request.description: Everything the user said about the party.

name: make_invitation
title: Make an invitation
